editor.premise: A morning at home, compressed into small routines that lead from waking up to breakfast in a prepared living room.

chapters.name: Wake and shower
chapters.purpose: Start immediately with routine; compress washing without showing every moment.

chapters.name: Personal care
chapters.purpose: Build a repeated rhythm of selecting, applying, and finishing.

chapters.name: Household reset
chapters.purpose: Extend personal preparation into getting the home in order.

chapters.name: Dress and accessorize
chapters.purpose: Complete getting ready through clothing and closely framed finishing touches.

chapters.name: Make breakfast
chapters.purpose: Turn ingredient gathering into a short, legible cooking sequence.

chapters.name: Make coffee
chapters.purpose: Give the drink its own assembly sequence beside the meal.

chapters.name: Settle in
chapters.purpose: Bring the prepared room, food, and drink together.

captions.note: Small centered timestamps persist across action runs, updating at routine changes. Occasional extra labels remain secondary to the pictures.

editor.notes: Keep most actions near half a second; allow pours and handling longer. Repeat fixed framings to make skips readable. Omit waiting, not necessary steps. Brief music detections do not establish deliberate song changes.
